verdict.rationale: Weave offers broad programmatic access: a REST Service API with a published OpenAPI spec, Python/TypeScript SDKs covering tracing, evaluations, scorers and custom costs, OTLP ingestion, and an official MCP server that gives agents access to traces and evaluations. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the UI, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, so this is partial. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement; API coverage for Playground (saved models, custom runtimes, model comparison), leaderboards, signals/alerts configuration and webhook automations; independent hands-on corroboration.
